pages.text:
# SUNNY, the Team's Assistant
SUNNY is a web app for every rep on the team. No download and no account: the first time you open it, just pick your own name.
Button: Open SUNNY (https://sunny-rsd.vercel.app)

## Add SUNNY to Your Home Screen
Add it once and it opens like an app.
iPhone
- Open SUNNY in Safari
- Tap the Share button
- Tap Add to Home Screen
Android
- Open SUNNY in Chrome
- Tap the ⋮ menu
- Tap Add to Home screen (or Install app)

## What You Can Do With SUNNY

### Ask SUNNY
Ask questions in plain words and get answers from the Team Policy and SUNNY's knowledge:
- Event policies
- Show charges and overages
- Scripts
- Mesa Marketplace
- Shift picking and levels
- Late fines
- Shift coverage rules
- Rep of Record rules
- "When is the next meeting?" (from Important Dates)

### ROR
Look up a customer's Rep of Record by name or address, with Call and Text buttons for that rep.

### Shifts
- See your own upcoming shifts from the Show Shift Board: who you work with and the show's status
- See a show's crew by day
- Freshmen and JV can request coverage for a shift (both reps confirm by text before anything moves)

### Contacts
Find a teammate's phone number by name or nickname.

## What SUNNY Doesn't Do
SUNNY doesn't assign shifts (go through Alan or Matt), change the schedule, or text anyone for you.

# Join the Rising Sun Events Team

## Joining RSD Show Team
This is a step-by-step process of starting with the Rising Sun Team. Make sure to complete all the following tasks below and you’ll start off the right way.
— Have all these completed before 1st Team Meeting —

### Step #1: Be at 15,000 in career sales AND attend RSD Events Training in August or January

### Step #2: Order Sharpeners & Admin on VectorConnect
- Item #82 Sharpener (via Vectorconnect: Cutco Orders - Non-Customer Orders - Buy Cutco Samples)
- Item #FS102 Ed Reed Sharpener (via Vectorconnect: Cutco Orders - Non-Customer Orders - Cutco Events Literature Order)
- Item #L17 - Cutco Events Order Form (pack of 50)
- Item #L419 - In-Home Sharpening Form (pack of 50)
- Item #L281 - Cutco Events Notepad (50 duplicate sheets)
- Item #L74 - Guarantee/DD Edge Sheet (laminated)
- Item #L355 - Family Program Brochure (laminate when it arrives)
- Item #L356 - Upgrade Program Brochure (laminate when it arrives)

### Step #3: Message Field Trainer(s) & Look Up Info for Event
- Click the “Team Contact Info” link on the homepage, find reps you’re field training with, and text them that you’re coming to field train.
- Google the info for the events you’re field training at for open/close times and locations (don’t ask the field trainer or Alan, must learn to find info personally).

### Step #4: Setup Schedule
- Click the “Important Dates” tab and put every team meeting for the campaign in your personal schedule.
- In-Person if you live within 1 hour of Office Address
- Via Zoom if you live outside of 1 hour of Office Address (you must be in meeting mode; no distractions and focus as if you’re in person)

### FAQ:
Click here for Commonly FAQ when you are new :) (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1X8HpH29aKhawyCHHpX-ekG8NZfdtaCU6_V1yx1AdeIM/edit)

Build simple, repeatable systems that make your money work for you. These tools help you track income, automate savings, and allocate your Cutco paychecks with purpose—so you’re not guessing where your money went every month.
